input: Use Christian camp and conference centers in Western North Carolina that run youth summer camps to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: Christian summer youth camps western North Carolina 2026 camp conference center
Christian camp Asheville Black Mountain Brevard 2026 summer Ridgecrest
Christian summer camp 2026 Rockmont Merri Mac Timberlake

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: Christian day, resident and adventure camps for children and teens; summer 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Christian day camps for younger children and overnight adventure camps through grade 10.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls; two-week summer 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Runs Lutheridge youth summer camps in Arden, including resident and outdoor-adventure programs.

candidates.name: Kanuga Conferences
candidates.note: Runs Camp Kanuga overnight and teen leadership programs plus Kanuga Day Camp for elementary children.

candidates.name: Ridge Haven
candidates.note: Summer 2026 camps served rising grades 3–12, with junior, junior-high, senior-high and service-project sessions.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Runs summer Clubs programs and weeklong youth conferences; 2027 youth conferences announced.

candidates.name: M28 Ministries
candidates.note: Four-day summer youth camps with worship, discipleship and recreation for middle and high school students.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Christian summer camp for boys ages 7–17; 2027 dates and rates announced.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Christian sleepaway summer camp for girls in Black Mountain.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Christian sleepaway summer camp for boys; campers attend the Marion campus.

candidates.name: Camps Kahdalea and Chosatonga
candidates.note: Separate Christian camps for girls and boys ages 8–17, with introductory sessions accepting age 7.

candidates.name: PASSPORT
candidates.note: Runs PASSPORTkids residential Christian camps at Montreat Conference Center.

candidates.name: Lifeway
candidates.note: Runs Centrifuge and MFuge youth summer camps at Ridgecrest Conference Center.
